## Talent is everywhere. Access to learning should be too. {#research-slide-3 .layout-split}

```{=html}
<div class="composition split"><div class="slide-copy"><h2>Talent is everywhere.<br>Access to learning should be too.</h2><div class="supporting"><p>Through Beautiful Gate, your work has helped remove mobility barriers for people like James Ahumbe.</p><p>We propose to build on that foundation through adaptive sampling and a participant register capturing people’s skills, interests and learning needs.</p><p>This would help us connect participants with suitable teaching, monitor their learning progress and adjust support as their needs change.</p></div></div><div class="slide-visual credited"><figure class="credited-photo"><img src="/photos/james-ahumbe-beautiful-gate.jpg" alt="James Ahumbe smiling while seated on a tricycle wheelchair, wearing a navy shirt and resting one hand on its red hand pedal."><figcaption class="photo-credit"><strong>James Ahumbe · Cobbler and Beautiful Gate beneficiary</strong><span>Photo published by Wheelchairs for Nigeria · <a href="https://www.wheelchairsfornigeria.org/_files/ugd/8d854e_ffd0fdd619874f11a285bcacaa816a64.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">July 2023, p. 3</a></span></figcaption></figure></div></div>
```
